evaluated_on: val, role==receptor & eligible, spatial NaN filled (see selected_features.json spatial_fill)

main.used_in: ablation rows 10, 11 and 12 only; not a selection candidate, not in features_final
main.definition: for each receptor, all other grid cells (self excluded) ordered by great-circle distance, nbr01 = nearest; per cell two raw values at hour t: pm2_5 and the stage 2 column pm2_5_change_3h (x(t) - x(t-3)); no averaging, no upwind weights
main.missing_rule: hours flagged qc_interpolated or is_missing are NaN (stage 2 masking rule, interpolation may use future endpoints); the column is kept, the value is not interpolated in time and not set to 0; the random forest handles NaN natively at each split

layout_check.definition: same raw values with one fixed column per grid cell (52 columns, the receptor's own cell left NaN), added to the previous Top-25; not plotted

control.definition: simple mean of nbr01..nbr03_pm2_5 (the 3 nearest cells)
control.missing_rule: mean of the available values; if none, the cell's own pm2_5 at t
